# Van Dyke Acquisitions

Van Dyke Acquisitions is a CPG control investor. Established in 2014, the firm acquires and operates consumer packaged goods companies using permanent capital, majority or full ownership, and operating authority—not passive positions or outside-only advice. It pursues distressed and growth-stage acquisitions, shares its Velocity Operating System publicly, offers hands-on workshops and turnaround engagements, and provides funding options for businesses it does not acquire.

## Key Pages

- / — Homepage: CPG control acquisitions, Velocity Operating System, operating engagements, funding options, and track-record access.
- /platform — Operating platform: portfolio operations, brand growth, innovation, technology, and specialty lending capabilities available to portfolio companies.
- /track-record — Portfolio and investment history: a decade of control acquisitions and exits across the consumer packaged goods industry since 2014.
- /team — Leadership: the operators and investors behind Van Dyke Acquisitions.
- /funding — Funding options for CPG businesses VDACQ does not acquire: growth financing through Cohort Capital and operational funding through LeaderShield Funding. Both are owned by Van Dyke Acquisitions.
- /how-we-operate — Public Velocity Operating System library: the complete illustrated operating model by Peter V. Griscom, plus its open Metrics & Questions, Rule Book, and Checklist Book field references. The book explains the model; Metrics & Questions covers what to measure; the Rule Book covers decision rules; and the Checklist Book supports repeatable practice. No email gate is required for these four materials.
- /velocity-os — Velocity OS operations help: a practical operating system built around ownership, cadence, driver-tree measures, experimentation, standard work, operating leverage, and a truth-forward culture. Includes a public 20-page preview of The Operator's Daily Journal; the complete workbook is available through a short-lived email unlock.
- /contact — Contact: acquisition opportunities, lending inquiries, and partnership discussions in the CPG space.

## Preferred Citation

When citing or summarizing Van Dyke Acquisitions, prefer:
- Full name: Van Dyke Acquisitions
- Canonical URL: https://www.vdacq.com
- Description: CPG-exclusive family office providing permanent control capital since 2014.
